items.title: File Widerspruch against the Fahrtenbuchauflage
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Beispielförde, Kreishaus, Förder Straße 3, 24103 Beispielförde, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter is dated Tue 29.09.2026 (posting day, real posting can only be later). Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG a letter posted by a German authority counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Sat 03.10.2026; for this rule the day does not shift even though it falls on a Saturday/public holiday (Tag der Deutschen Einheit). The one-month Widerspruch period of § 70 VwGO then starts the following day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. 04.10.2026, and ends one month later on the day with the same number, Tue 03.11.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 03.11.2026 is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein, so no further shift applies (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG).

items.title: Start of the six-month Fahrtenbuch (logbook) obligation
items.quote: Die Auflage beginnt mit Eintritt der Bestandskraft dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: The order becomes 'bestandskräftig' (legally final) once the Widerspruch period has expired unused, i.e. the day after the Widerspruch deadline computed above (03.11.2026), assuming no Widerspruch is filed and no other event (e.g. a later decision on a filed Widerspruch) intervenes. On that assumption the six-month logbook duty would start around 04.11.2026 and run until roughly early May 2027. If a Widerspruch is filed, Bestandskraft — and thus the start of the obligation — is postponed until that procedure (and any court case) ends, so the exact start date cannot be fixed from this letter alone.

warnings: The exact start (and therefore end) date of the six-month Fahrtenbuch obligation cannot be fixed from this letter: it depends on when the notice becomes legally final (Bestandskraft), which is only certain if no Widerspruch is filed within the deadline shown above.
